7/ Do memecoins have a future? 🔮

While most are speculative, some memecoins are evolving:
• $DOGE is exploring utility for payments.
• $SHIB is building its own ecosystem with NFTs and DeFi.

Memecoins may survive by adding real-world value. Until then, they’re for fun. 😅

2/ How did it all start? 🐕

$DOGE was created in 2013 as a parody of Bitcoin.
It features the iconic Shiba Inu “Doge” meme.

Fast forward to 2021:
🚀 Elon Musk tweeted about $DOGE, sparking a meteoric rise.
Fun fact: $DOGE started as a joke, but it’s now worth billions! 🤯

Memecoins are cryptocurrencies inspired by internet memes, jokes, or pop culture.
They often have:
✅ A loyal fanbase
✅ Fun marketing
✅ Little or no real utility

Famous examples: $DOGE 🐕 (the OG) and $SHIB 🐕‍🦺 (the “Dogecoin killer”).

🐶🚀 Memecoins: A Joke or the Future of Crypto? 🧵

Memecoins like $DOGE and $SHIB started as jokes, but some people made millions 💰.
Here’s what you need to know before jumping into the world of memecoins. Spoiler: It’s risky but fun! 🐕👇
